Approve a non-reconstructive aggregation design that publishes no text, titles, authors, URLs, identifiers, source metadata, or document rows.

blockers.summary: Obtain a versioned archive with inventory and checksums, or an immutable provider manifest plus permission for a controlled archival copy.
Define a reproducible acquisition path without committing passwords, transient download URLs, or raw corpus files to the public repository.
After acquisition, validate the delivered language composition and schema, then approve rights-, privacy-, and disclosure-safe aggregate outputs before publication.
